Name: Books A Million
Description: Books-A-Million, Inc., is the second-largest book retailer in the nation, operating more than 200 stores in 32 states and online at Booksamillion.com. The company also owns 2nd & Charles, a fast-growing new and used bookstore and pop culture purveyor with more than 40 stores in 18 states and counting. Headquartered in Birmingham, AL, Books-A-Million maintains strong roots in Florence, AL, where it began as a street-corner newsstand in 1917 and still operates its wholesale and distribution subsidiary, American Wholesale Book Company.
Reason:
Books-A-Million operates physical bookstores alongside an e-commerce platform and provides customer support through live chat, email, and phone for online orders, store purchases, shipping, and returns. Its customer-service operations also cover multiple retail brands, including 2nd & Charles, making it a relevant prospect for Inspiro’s omnichannel customer support and order-management services.

Best outreach angle: Omnichannel customer support, online order management, returns, and seasonal demand.

Name: Micro Center
Description: Micro Center is the nation’s leading computer and electronic device retailer. Our technology super store has an industry-leading 40,000+ selection of premier brands and the most knowledgeable staff in the business. Founded in 1979 in Columbus, Ohio, we have grown steadily and profitably to a nationwide presence. Our brick-and-mortar stores attract a wide range of customers – from casual to tech-savvy – with highly trained associates who offer technical solutions in an immersive shopping environment. Micro Center has been ranked by one of the leading consumer advocacy magazines as a top walk-in store to purchase a PC based on selection, service and pricing!
Reason:
Micro Center combines physical electronics retail with online ordering, in-store pickup, hardware repair, and technical support services. Its PriorityCare+ membership includes remote and in-store technical assistance, creating a strong functional match for Inspiro’s customer service and technical support capabilities, particularly for order inquiries and first-level troubleshooting.

Best outreach angle: First-level technical support, customer service efficiency, and online order assistance.

Name: Bluemercury
Description:
With locations in coveted neighborhoods across the country, Bluemercury takes beauty personally. Founded on a client-first service model that emphasizes hyper-personalized, high-quality experiences, the leading luxury beauty destination and Macy’s, Inc. nameplate offers a highly curatedand premiumproduct assortment across a range of categories. Bluemercury is redefining modern luxury in beauty and as it evolves, it remainscommitted to its exceptional customer service origins and embraces itspurpose to be the ultimate specialist in the beauty of its clients.

For more information, please visit www.bluemercury.com.
Reason:
Bluemercury is a luxury beauty and spa retailer owned by Macy’s, Inc., operating both physical stores and an e-commerce business with customer-service processes covering online orders, returns, exchanges, and loyalty accounts. Macy’s has also identified Bluemercury’s physical and digital expansion as part of its luxury growth strategy, making consistent omnichannel support and premium customer experience relevant opportunities for Inspiro.

Best outreach angle: Premium omnichannel customer experience, e-commerce support, and consistent service during expansion.

Name: Neiman Marcus
Description:
Neiman Marcus is a leading luxury retailer that provides a curated product assortment, unparalleled services, and exclusive activations for customers in Pursuit of the Extraordinary. It is known for creating the Neiman Marcus magic through exceptional customer experiences including the Neiman Marcus Awards, Fantasy Gifts, seasonal campaigns, and “Retail-tainment” initiatives. Neiman Marcus has a rich history as a brand builder, bringing together the world's top luxury designers and customers to foster a dedicated following for generations. It serves customers across its stores, digital channels, and through remote selling. Neiman Marcus is part of Exemplar Luxury Group (formerly Saks Global), the luxury collective uniting coveted brands with unrivaled customer experiences.

Interested in joining our team shaping the future of luxury retail? Explore exciting career opportunities with us here: https://careers.saksglobal.com/us/en/
Reason:
Neiman Marcus operates as part of Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly Saks Global, alongside Saks Fifth Avenue and Bergdorf Goodman. Following its emergence from Chapter 11 restructuring in June 2026, the group identified operational stability, profitable growth, and personalized luxury customer experiences as priorities, creating a relevant opportunity for Inspiro’s customer experience operations and service-efficiency capabilities.

Best outreach angle: Post-restructuring customer experience optimization, operational efficiency, and premium customer support.

Name: Edible Arrangements
Description:
Edible® is the original fresh fruit bouquet company and a leader in handcrafted, delicious gifts. From chocolate-dipped fruit and fresh arrangements to flowers, baked goods, balloons, and plush, we help people celebrate life’s moments with a memorable twist.

Founded in 1999, our passion for creativity and innovation drives everything we do — because whatever you're celebrating, there’s an Edible for that. Every experience is designed to deliver one thing: a big, bold WOW.
Reason:
Edible operates more than 650 stores across North America, combining physical retail, e-commerce, and gift delivery. The company has expanded its digital marketplace and delivery capabilities, with its website reporting the ability to deliver to more than 80% of U.S. ZIP codes within an hour. Its large delivery network, multiple ordering channels, and time-sensitive fulfillment operations make it a strong candidate for Inspiro's customer experience and order-support services.

Best outreach angle: Seasonal demand scaling, time-sensitive delivery support, order tracking, and delivery issue resolution

Name: FTD
Description: For over 110 years we’ve been helping people across the country do more than just send flowers and gifts. Along with our network of expert florists, we help you give joy, strength and love. And most importantly, we help you give it with meaning.
Reason:
FTD operates a large flower and gift delivery business supported by a network of more than 30,000 florist shops across over 125 countries. Its official customer-service page confirms 24/7 support covering order modifications, delivery tracking, missed deliveries, refunds, and customer complaints. These established support operations and seasonal delivery requirements closely match the retail CX services Inspiro has delivered for floral and gifting businesses.

Best outreach angle: Peak-season customer support, 24/7 service coverage, delivery coordination, and order-related escalations

Name: Living Spaces Furniture
Description:
Living Spaces is a home furnishing brand with stores expanding throughout the United States in addition to a robust online presence. Living Spaces not only sells an impressive assortment of furniture and accessories, we also stir the imagination and inspire great design - both home and beyond.

We believe that a great Team member experience leads to an even better guest experience. That is why we place a huge emphasis on building an incredible culture within our teams. Now is the time to take advantage of the incredible opportunity to become a Team member at Living Spaces. We know that your contribution has the ability to transform lives, both inside and outside our locations. Living Spaces is not just a job; it is a place to change, grow and influence those around you.

Come join the journey with us!
Reason:
Living Spaces is a U.S. furniture retailer offering online ordering, home delivery, assembly, and post-purchase support. Its website confirms that customer-service representatives are available seven days a week, from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m., assisting with order changes, delivery scheduling, cancellations, and returns. These documented processes make it relevant to Inspiro's customer support and back-office operations capabilities.

Best outreach angle: Delivery scheduling and coordination, order management, returns, and post-purchase customer support

Name: Altar'd State
Description: Altar’d State is a rapidly growing women’s fashion and lifestyle brand rooted in community and committed to giving back. From welcoming experiences and warm associates to thoughtfully curated products in-store and online, it is a place of beauty from the inside out. Altar’d State is built upon the founding principles of giving back and making a difference in the world. Locally and globally, Altar’d State has partnered with over 4,000 nonprofits that provide food, clothing, resources, education, and love to those in need. Your talents, our team – creating excellence together.
Reason:
Altar'd State is part of Stand Out For Good, a U.S. retail group operating five brands across different consumer categories. Its official website confirms that customers can purchase products through physical stores, online platforms, and telephone ordering, with shipping and returns processes covering its operations. This multi-brand, multichannel business model makes it a strong potential fit for centralized customer-service and order-management support.

Best outreach angle: Centralized multi-brand customer service, omnichannel support, order management, and returns

Name: EVEREVE
Description:
EVEREVE is a coast-to-coast retailer with a boutique feel and unmatched personal service, offering a curated collection of elevated, contemporary, versatile brands for women who are ever-evolving in life and style. 

We have 100 stores in 30+ states, an e-boutique at EVEREVE.com, daily programming on @evereveofficial, and a digital personal styling service at TRENDSEND.com. 

Our collections are created from a select group of emerging and established brands such as Monrow, Faherty, The Upside, Parker Clay, Pistola, Cleobella, Vuori, AGOLDE, Citizens of Humanity, Velvet, and many more. We are poised to deliver a unique and unforgettable experience to a large and growing addressable market.
Reason:
EVEREVE operates 116 U.S. stores and an e-commerce business, alongside Trendsend, its personalized styling-box service, which has processed more than one million boxes. The company also reports reaching two million unique customers and expanding its corporate office and retail footprint in 2026. Its combination of retail expansion, online shopping, and personalized order fulfillment makes it relevant to Inspiro's customer experience and business process services.

Best outreach angle: Customer support during retail expansion, e-commerce order management, personalized styling fulfillment, and returns
